divisions.title: Day of the LORD Against Judah
divisions.summary: God announces cosmic judgment beginning with Judah: idolatry, complacency, and violence will be consumed in the great day of the LORD.

divisions.title: Judgment on the Nations
divisions.theme: No nation escapes the LORD's justice
divisions.summary: Philistia, Moab, Ammon, Cush, and Assyria face destruction, yet the humble who seek the LORD may find shelter.

divisions.title: Woe and Restoration
divisions.summary: Jerusalem's corrupt leaders condemned, then purified. The LORD removes judgment, gathers the outcasts, and rejoices over his people with singing.

chapterSummaries.1: The Day of the LORD sweeps away everything in Judah
chapterSummaries.3: Jerusalem condemned then restored with joy

3.title: Sing, the LORD rejoices over you
